name: Contoso AVD - Session redirection controls
description: Settings Catalog policy for Azure Virtual Desktop clipboard transfer direction on pooled session hosts.

settings.settingPickerPath: Administrative templates > Windows Components > Remote Desktop Services > Remote Desktop Session Host > Device and Resource Redirection > Restrict clipboard transfer from server to client

displayNames: Restrict clipboard transfer from server to client

settings.why: Limits copy from the remote session to the client to plain text. This reduces data exfiltration risk while keeping basic text copy available for users who need it.

settings.settingPickerPath: Administrative templates > Windows Components > Remote Desktop Services > Remote Desktop Session Host > Device and Resource Redirection > Restrict clipboard transfer from client to server

displayNames: Restrict clipboard transfer from client to server

settings.why: Limits copy from the client to the remote session to plain text. The host pool RDP property must still allow clipboard redirection, otherwise clipboard is completely blocked.

settings.settingPickerPath: Administrative templates > Windows Components > Remote Desktop Services > Remote Desktop Session Host > Device and Resource Redirection > Do not allow Clipboard redirection
settings.why: Leaves clipboard redirection available so the transfer-direction settings can apply. Set this to enabled only for personas where all clipboard redirection should be blocked.
